context.pubinfo_note: From the Consilience cross-theory demo (consilience-demo.netlify.app); its results are pinned in https://github.com/Anuja-Khatri/theconsilience-engine at commit 96ba4e435bd13718d36435cc3436d938d2d1f894, results/demo/. The demo's check rules this disagreement decidable now and names the shared observable both claims bear on; it names no instrument, so none is recorded. This is a statement about the two claims, not a verdict on either theory. The dimension is a dimension of theoretical commitment, not a quantity, so no margin or floor applies. The claim statements in the linked claim cards are reviewed paraphrases with page locators, not quotations.

left.statement: The richness and level of consciousness increase with the diversity and specialization of causal connections; homogeneous connectivity reduces consciousness.
left.direction: “The richness and level of consciousness increase with the diversity and specialization of causal connections; homogeneous connectivity reduces consciousness.” (c025) — expected on shared observables: connectivity_metrics

right.statement: Without a functional global neuronal workspace, cortical representations cannot be broadcast and are not experienced; functional connectivity of GNW is a necessary condition for consciousness.
right.direction: “Without a functional global neuronal workspace, cortical representations cannot be broadcast and are not experienced; functional connectivity of GNW is a necessary condition for consciousness.” (c008) — expected on shared observables: connectivity_metrics
